text_block_list.text:
A long time ago, I used to play café pretend with a friend.
There was only a single item on the menu. Because that was—

text_block_list.name: Fishmonger
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about compensating me!
I was rushing back to the shop too, so we're even!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
B-But...! Because I bumped into you, the fish you were selling fell onto the ground...
I really should buy them from you...!

text_block_list.name: Fishmonger
text_block_list.text: Hmm... In that case, in exchange, there's a place I'd like you to go to—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... Why do I always end up messing up like this...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Welcome.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, was this your shop, Cafe-san...?
Um, a seat all the way in the corner is totally fine with meee...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, ah, actually, I don't even need a seat! I can just stand in the corner next to that cat tree~...
Someone like me who only makes mistakes doesn't deserve one...!!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
............
I will brew some coffee for you.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you for waiting.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...Ah! A raccoon dog latte art!
Hawawa, it's so cute... and also—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Looking at the raccoon dog's round, bead-like eyes... somehow... makes me feel so relaxed... and spellbound—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
So many stars...
Every single star is shining with such grand dignity—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Doto-san, please look.
That is... Jupiter.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
That eye-like pattern... inside it,
Earth... fits completely.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Eeeehhh!? Earth fits inside there...?
Just how many hundreds of millions of times bigger is that than my face, I wonderrr??

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Light travels. From distant, distant stars.
Taking millions of years... hundreds of millions of years,
to reach... us.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
That's an unfathomable amount of time, isn't it...?
I see, so that's how it is...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Within this profound, boundless world,
everything is small... everything is just a fleeting moment.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...We ourselves, our very lives.
And of course... the events that happen within our lives as well.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Everything is small... and I myself, too...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hu-Hunya... huh...?
When did I fall asleep—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It seems you were able to relax comfortably...
I am glad.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
A-Aaaah...!!
Falling fast asleep in a shop...!
I went and messed up again—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
—...No.
Maybe something like this is... just a tiny little thing, after all.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Cafe-san, thank you so much for the coffee.
It was really delicious!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I shall be waiting for your next visit.
Together with a cup brewed just for you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while walking through the academy—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
That's right! The coffee was so good,
I was just thinking how much I'd love
to visit that coffee shop again...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
We should be able to go back.
Now that I know for sure it wasn't just my dream.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tsk... But seriously, what the hell was that?
That completely illogical damn space.
